title: Codex delegation trace
description: Every invocation of the codex skill in delegate, consult, or roundtable mode must emit a trace conforming to this schema. The trace is what evals score — not the raw model output. Designed with Codex (GPT-5.x) collaboratively; informed by OpenTelemetry span conventions and Anthropic's skill-creator evals framework.

trace_id.description: UUID; one per full skill invocation (may span multiple turns).

parent_trace_id.description: If this trace is part of a larger workflow.

task.description: One-sentence goal. If this is longer than one sentence the spec is too broad.

context_refs.description: File paths, URLs, or artifact IDs given to the worker. Avoid pasting raw context — reference it.

context_digest.description: SHA-256 of the prompt+context bundle. Used to detect context drift across runs.

required_output_format.description: If structured output expected: schema path, format name, or natural-language contract.

driver_position.description: withheld = driver did NOT share their view (independent-first); provided = driver shared their view explicitly; none = no prior position existed.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observable pass/fail checks the driver will use to verify.

artifact.description: Worker output, or path to a file containing it.

artifact_kind.description: Helps the eval pick the right verifier.

evidence.description: Structured, not free-text. Empty array means worker provided no evidence — driver should flag.

assumptions.description: Things worker assumed when answering. Empty = worker either had no assumptions or didn't surface them (interpret with care).

known_gaps.description: Things worker flagged as unverified or out of its knowledge.

status.description: How the worker handled the driver's question framing.

reframed_question.description: If status != accepted, what question did the worker actually answer?

verifier.description: Who performed verification. 'none' should be rare and explicit.

integrated_by_driver.description: Did the driver actually use the worker's output?

driver_changes_made.description: Edits/decisions the driver took based on the response.

worker_output_modified.description: True if the driver edited the worker's output before integrating (rather than pass-through).
